This inventory was reviewed on 2026-09-09 against Azunote's restored
`net10.0-windows10.0.19041.0` / `win-x64` dependencies, with Native AOT and
self-contained Windows App SDK deployment enabled. It conservatively includes
notices for runtime dependencies even when trimming or unused SDK features may

binary, or that all redistribution conditions have been satisfied.

restored NuGet packages; the Windows SDK RTF comes from its official license URL.

## Redistribution requirements

- **zlib:** preserve the notice in source distributions, identify altered source
  versions, and do not misrepresent authorship. Product acknowledgment is
  optional. Azunote also ships its own license with binaries for clarity.
- **BSD and MIT dependencies:** include their copyright notices, license
  conditions, and disclaimers with redistributed code, including code linked
  into a Native AOT executable. A package name or website link alone does not
  reproduce these notices. Preserve the supplied third-party notices as well.
- **Windows App SDK:** the NuGet binary license applies separately from the
  upstream source repository's MIT license. Section 3 permits redistribution
  of files placed with the application by the package, but also sets distribution
  requirements, including significant application functionality and terms
  protecting Microsoft that distributors and external end users must agree to.
  Section 4(c) prohibits removing or modifying notices. Merely copying these
  documents does not implement an end-user agreement or settle those obligations.
- **Windows SDK and ML components:** retain their separate terms and review
  their redistribution requirements for the components actually shipped.

The build copies `LICENSE`, this document, and `licenses/` to Azunote's output
and publish directories. Include all of them in ZIPs, installers, or other
binary distributions. No About dialog is required solely to carry the BSD/MIT
notices when the complete texts accompany the distribution.

## Open release checks

1. **Win2D 1.3.2:** its `.nuspec` requires license acceptance and points to the
   EULA URL above, but the URL redirected to an unrelated Microsoft Learn page
   during this review. The package contains no license text. The
   [Win2D source license](https://github.com/microsoft/Win2D/blob/winappsdk/main/LICENSE.txt)
   is MIT; it is not evidence that the prebuilt NuGet binary has the same terms.
   Obtain the applicable binary EULA from Microsoft and bundle it before release.
2. Review and satisfy the Microsoft binary distribution conditions, including
   the agreement requirement, for the intended distribution channel. This notice
   file is not an EULA, and Azunote's zlib license applies to its original code.
3. Audit the actual clean Release publish output. Match native DLLs and linked
   runtime code to their packages, including any additional VC++ runtime,
   WebView2 runtime, or externally downloaded ML components if shipped. This
   review used the restored dependency graph, not a completed release artifact.
4. On dependency, SDK, target framework, or deployment-mode changes, refresh
   this inventory and the upstream texts and hashes. Do not infer license terms
   solely from a repository's current default branch.

## Build and test dependencies

CsWin32, Windows SDK build tools (including WinApp and MSIX), Win32 metadata and
documentation packages, ILLink, compiler tooling, and test packages are not
listed as shipped application libraries solely because they participate in the
build. Their own terms still govern their use. If redistributing those tools,
their binaries, or copied source, review and include the applicable notices.
Generated code and runtime support require separate consideration; Native AOT
runtime and Windows SDK projection terms are included above. Test dependencies
such as xUnit and Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk are not part of an ordinary Azunote
publish output.
